thread:
Alex W: heads-up — after rolling driver 53901 to canary h100-pool we see a kernel-selector entropy spike. short sequences (<=64) suddenly prefer the vectorized attn path, causing p95+ latency regressions.
Maria K: reproed on perf-ci: p50 went 21ms -> 35ms, p95 45ms -> 90ms for seq=32 batch=16
Chris P: kv-cache hit-rate steady, but batching heuristics now produce smaller groups (avg batch dropped 16->11) — looks like grouping threshold changed
infra-bot: canary deployed driver=53901 to h100-canary-3 at 2026-03-18T12:10:03Z
Sasha L: attaching quick flame graph from perf-run (link: https://artifacts.redwood/perf/1715010000/flame.svg)
Sasha L: ```
# short excerpt
attn_vectorized_kernel: 62%
attn_legacy_kernel: 28%
other: 10%
```
Jordan M: interesting — autotuner's kernel-score now favors vectorized due to lower measured cycles for short seqs in microbenchmarks; might be cuBLAS/driver updated timings instead of our heuristics changing
Neha R: mitigation idea: force kernel-selector to prefer legacy path for seq<=64 until root cause is known. runtime override: `REDWOOD_RUNTIME_FORCE_KERNEL=legacy_attn:seq<=64`
Alex W: can we do immediate canary rollback of driver on canary nodes and enable kernel override globally for hosted API? ops: thoughts?
Chris P: ops+infra agree on two-step: 1) flip override on hosted (low-risk) 2) rollback driver on canary if override doesn't fix p95. I'll open a rollback PR now
Maria K: adding a smoke check to perf-regressions dashboard: seq 8/32/64 qps sweep + per-route p95 alert
Jordan M: ran an in-prod smoke patch with the override — p95 back to ~48ms on seq=32 batch=16. promising but need larger sample
infra-bot: rollback job created: rollback-driver-53901 -> 53788 (PR #2841)
Alex W: action items: Chris open rollback PR & schedule canary rollback window; Maria add dashboard tiles + alert; Jordan dig into autotuner weighting change and microbench harness; Sasha collect full profiles and upload; Neha coordinate runtime flag rollout and docs
Neha R: noted — will push override in 15m behind feature-flag `kernel-selector-override` and notify hosted teams
Chris P: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/rollbacks/pull/2841 (contains rollback plan, smoke test steps, and rollback window)
Alex W: thanks — let's capture findings in a short postmortem after stabilization. if p95 > 80ms after mitigations, page oncall and escalate. :phone:
